en.label: A Worker stops in the middle of a Flow, and a new Worker finishes it

events.text: Worker 1 runs Charge. Dex saves its result.
Ship waits on a 30-second Timer. Dex Server holds the wait.
Worker 1 stops.
The Timer keeps running on Dex Server. No Worker is needed.
Worker 2 starts and connects to Dex.
The Timer fires.
Worker 2 runs Ship. Charge does not run again.
The Flow completes.

en.summary: Charge ran once. Ship ran once.

zh-Hans.label: Worker 在 Flow 中途停止，新的 Worker 把它跑完

events.text: Worker 1 运行 Charge。Dex 保存它的结果。
Ship 等一个 30 秒的 Timer。这个等待由 Dex Server 保管。
Worker 1 停止。
Timer 在 Dex Server 上继续计时，不需要 Worker。
Worker 2 启动并连接 Dex。
Timer 到时。
Worker 2 运行 Ship。Charge 不会再运行。
Flow 完成。

zh-Hans.summary: Charge 只运行了一次，Ship 只运行了一次。

en.label: A Worker stops while a tool call waits for approval, and the session carries on after a restart

events.text: RunModel calls the model. The model asks to call cancel_order.
cancel_order waits in AwaitToolApproval. Dex Server holds the wait.
The Worker stops.
The approval keeps waiting on Dex Server. No Worker is needed.
The Worker starts again and connects to Dex.
You approve cancel_order in Dex Web.
cancel_order runs once. The model writes the reply.
The turn completes.

en.summary: The model call before the stop did not run again. cancel_order ran once.

zh-Hans.label: 工具调用等待审批时 Worker 停止，重启后会话继续

events.text: RunModel 调用模型。模型请求调用 cancel_order。
cancel_order 在 AwaitToolApproval 中等待。这个等待由 Dex Server 保管。
Worker 停止。
审批继续在 Dex Server 上等待，不需要 Worker。
Worker 重新启动并连接 Dex。
你在 Dex Web 里批准 cancel_order。
cancel_order 只运行一次。模型写出回复。
这一轮完成。

zh-Hans.summary: 停止前的模型调用没有再运行，cancel_order 只运行了一次。
